note: Authored once, reused by every scene. This is Stage 2 of design/13-migration-plan.md — the Calling Cards, 8 Callings × situation kinds, which was the highest-yield migration in the project because the prose already existed. A scene gets these for free and only has to author what is specific to it.

actions.label: Mount the cannon on something that will hold.
actions.detail: It has sat under a tarpaulin for eight years. The carriage is rotten through.

strong.narrate: It will hold. You know exactly how long it will hold, which is not as long as anybody watching believes.

partial.narrate: It will hold. Nobody asks how long and you do not volunteer it.

weak.narrate: The axle splits while four men are watching. You will need the whole afternoon and somebody's wagon.

actions.label: Shoe the horses that are going out.
actions.detail: A rider with a thrown shoe is a rider who does not arrive.

strong.narrate: Every horse leaving this town today leaves sound. Somebody will get somewhere because of that and never know why.

partial.narrate: Most of them. You run out of iron before you run out of horses.

weak.narrate: You are still working when the first rider goes without you.

actions.label: Ride for help before anyone tells you not to.
actions.detail: Mina is forty miles. San Felipe is eighty. Nobody there knows anything yet.

strong.narrate: You are gone before the argument in the square has finished. By tonight two more towns know.

partial.narrate: You get there. It costs you a horse and a day.

weak.narrate: The road is longer than the map says and you arrive after somebody else's rumour did.

actions.label: Ride the Béxar road until you can see something.
actions.detail: Ahead of the news is the only place you are ever any use.

strong.narrate: Dust, four hours west, moving at the pace of men on foot. You have bought this town most of a day.

partial.narrate: Nothing on the road. That is worth knowing and it is not worth much.

weak.narrate: You go further than you meant to and come back later than you should have.

actions.label: Cite the document, by name, in front of everyone.
actions.detail: Chapter and verse. It is the only weapon you brought.

strong.narrate: The square goes quiet while you read it. Whatever they do next, they do it knowing what they swore.
strong.broadcast: {name} read the oath aloud in the square, and the square went quiet.

partial.narrate: Half of them listen. That is more than usually listen.

weak.narrate: You are right, and you are the fourth person to say something this minute.

actions.label: Write the letter that goes with the rider.
actions.detail: A man arriving with a story is a rumour. A man arriving with a letter is news.

strong.narrate: Dated, signed, and specific about numbers. Committees act on paper like this and ignore men who only talk.

partial.narrate: It says what happened. It does not say what you want them to do about it.

weak.narrate: You write it twice and the rider leaves with the first draft.

actions.label: Name somebody who owes you. Out loud.
actions.detail: Credit is what this frontier actually runs on.

strong.narrate: They help you, in front of witnesses, and everyone watching learns what the ledger is worth in this town.

partial.narrate: They help you, and they will remember being made to.

weak.narrate: They pay you instead, in front of everybody, and now they owe you nothing at all.

actions.label: Put together what the riders will need.
actions.detail: Corn, a blanket, and somewhere to change horses at the far end.

strong.narrate: Two days of food and a name at the other end who will not ask questions.

partial.narrate: Enough to get there. Not enough to get back.

weak.narrate: You give away more than the town could spare, and everyone saw you do it.

actions.label: Say the true number of days this town can eat.
actions.detail: Everyone must act on it. That is what the number is for.

strong.narrate: Forty days. You say it flatly and the argument changes shape around it.
strong.broadcast: {name} said the number out loud: forty days of food, twelve rounds of powder.

partial.narrate: Forty days. Two men tell you that you are wrong. You are not.

weak.narrate: You say it and it lands in the middle of a shouting match and is gone.

actions.label: Say plainly who cannot travel.
actions.detail: The old, the sick, the very young, and whoever has to mind them.

strong.narrate: You name them, and in naming them you make them somebody's responsibility instead of nobody's.

partial.narrate: The list is longer than anybody expected it to be.

weak.narrate: You are told, kindly, that this is not the moment. It is exactly the moment.

actions.label: Assert a claim older than anybody's deed.
actions.detail: No one may out-argue it without producing a document.

strong.narrate: Your family held this ground under a Spanish grant before the colony existed. Nobody in the square has paper that beats it, and everybody now knows it.

partial.narrate: It is accepted, with the faint surprise of people who had not thought about it.

weak.narrate: Somebody asks, loudly, whose side you are on. That is the whole answer to your claim.

actions.label: Take them the way your family goes.
actions.detail: There is a road, and there is the way people who live here actually travel.

strong.narrate: Half a day saved, and a crossing nobody watching the road would think to watch.

partial.narrate: Faster, and wetter. They will complain and they will arrive.

weak.narrate: Two of them will not follow a Tejano off the road. They take the long way and say why.

actions.label: Take someone's hands and steady them.
actions.detail: Half this town has not slept. It shows.

all.narrate: They are steadier for it, and so are you.

actions.label: Stand where the rider can see you.
actions.detail: Say nothing. Just be visible, and be armed.

all.narrate: He counts you. That is what he came to do, and now his count includes a man who meant to be counted.

actions.label: Count who in this town can actually shoot.
actions.detail: Not who says they can. Who can.

all.narrate: Eighteen. Maybe twenty if you count two boys and a man with one good arm. That is the whole of it.

actions.label: Help {adjacent}. Give them your hands for one turn.
actions.detail: They get a better roll. You get nothing but the Legacy.

all.narrate: You do the unglamorous half of somebody else's job, and it goes better than it would have.

actions.label: Stand in front of {adjacent}.
actions.detail: One consequence lands on you instead of them.

all.narrate: Nothing happens to you. That is the point of it, and it is why nobody will mention it later.

actions.label: Do nothing, and keep your Word for later.
actions.detail: Sometimes this is the right answer. It is not a wasted turn.

all.narrate: You keep your mouth shut and your powder dry, and the day goes on without your help.

actions._why_gated: HOLD keeps its Resolve clause everywhere EXCEPT a fight. In a BATTLE or SIEGE the fight-time variant below is offered instead, without the clear_resolve — in a fight you get your feet back from somebody else (MEND), not from standing still. Removing the clause outright would have punished the four quiet scenes where holding really is the right answer.

actions.label: Keep your head down and wait it out.
actions.detail: Sometimes this is the right answer. It will not get your feet back.

all.narrate: You stay where you are and let it go over you. Nothing about you is better for it, and you are still here.

actions.label: Hold the line where it is thinnest.
actions.detail: Three rounds a minute, if your hands are steady.

strong.narrate: You hold, and the men either side of you hold because you did.

partial.narrate: You hold. It costs powder you will want later.

weak.narrate: The line holds without you being much use to it.

actions.label: Cut up scrap iron and chain for the gun.
actions.detail: There is no proper shot. There never was.

strong.narrate: Chain, nails, and a broken plough share. It is not artillery. It will do exactly once.

partial.narrate: Enough for a load. You will be doing this again in an hour.

weak.narrate: You cut your hand badly and keep working.

actions.label: Get around behind them and look.
actions.detail: Somebody has to know what is actually there.

strong.narrate: You come back with numbers instead of rumours, which is the rarest thing in this war.

partial.narrate: You get a look. Some of it is even right.

weak.narrate: You come back certain of something that turns out to be grass.

actions.label: Keep the powder moving to whoever is shooting.
actions.detail: An army runs on this and nobody writes songs about it.

strong.narrate: Every company has what it needs when it needs it. Nobody will remember that this was a person doing it.

partial.narrate: Most of them, most of the time.

weak.narrate: You are carrying a keg to the wrong end of the line when it matters.

actions.label: Take the column through streets you know.
actions.detail: The Anglos have never been inside Béxar. You have.

strong.narrate: You put three hundred men where they need to be, through yards and alleys nobody outside this town knows exist.

partial.narrate: They follow you. Two of them complain the whole way.

weak.narrate: Somebody says out loud that they are being led by a Mexican. In Béxar. Into a fight against Mexicans.

actions.label: Work on whoever is brought to you.
actions.detail: This is the job. It does not stop when the shooting does.

all.narrate: They live, or they do not, and either way somebody was with them. You will do this again tomorrow.

actions.label: Write down what actually happened, while it is happening.
actions.detail: In thirty years this will be the only account that is not a legend.

strong.narrate: Names, times, numbers, and what people actually said. Everything anybody knows about today will come from this.

partial.narrate: You get most of it. You will fill the gaps later and not mark which parts.

weak.narrate: You write it afterwards, from memory, and it is already becoming a better story than it was.

actions.label: Hold a town that has no men left in it.
actions.detail: They all went to Béxar. Somebody is still here.

strong.narrate: Fed, watched, and running. A town does not stop needing to be a town because there is a siege seventy miles away.

partial.narrate: It holds together. Barely, and by people nobody is counting.

weak.narrate: Something goes wrong that would not have gone wrong with twenty more hands here.

actions.label: Put the long rifle on something a long way off.
actions.detail: Two hundred yards. You do not have to be near it.

strong.narrate: You lie down, take your time, and read the ground at two hundred yards better than anybody who walked out to look at it.
strong.broadcast: Somebody is reading the far ground through a rifle sight.

partial.narrate: You get a long look before the barrel fouls. It is enough to say what is out there, and not how much of it.

weak.narrate: A full minute to load, and by the time you are ready the thing you were watching has moved.

actions.label: Load the Bess again. And again.
actions.detail: Paper cartridge, no patching. You are not fast at anything else.

strong.narrate: Three in a minute. None of them accurate, all of them arriving, which at fifty yards is the whole argument.

partial.narrate: Two, and the second one goes wide. You are still reloading before anybody else has started.

weak.narrate: You spill a cartridge in the dirt and have to start it over.

actions.label: Fix it yourself. You are carrying the tools.
actions.detail: You are not a smith. You have a smith’s tools and one go at it.

strong.narrate: It is not a good repair and it is a repair. Whatever it was for, it will do that again today.
strong.broadcast: Somebody who is not a smith fixes it anyway.

partial.narrate: You get it holding. Do not lean on it.

weak.narrate: You make it worse, then slightly less worse, and give the tools back.

actions.label: Steady. Say exactly what your hands do.
actions.detail: Your next Arms roll of 7–9 counts as a 10 or better.
actions._ability: STEADY — once per session, printed on the RIFLEMAN Calling Card.

all.narrate: You set your feet, and you say out loud what your hands are doing. The next one that matters goes the way you meant it to.
all.broadcast: Somebody has gone steady, and is not going to miss the one that counts.

actions.label: Declare you are somewhere else. You already left.
actions.detail: You are there. Your movement comes back, all of it.
actions._ability: AHEAD OF THE NEWS — once per session, printed on the RIDER Calling Card.

all.narrate: You are not where anybody thought you were. You left before the argument started, which is the entire point of being the one on the horse.
all.broadcast: Somebody is already gone, and is somewhere else by now.

actions.label: Turn a broken thing into a working one. Name the material.
actions.detail: Not bought, not found. Made, here, out of what there is.
actions._ability: MADE, NOT BOUGHT — once per session, printed on the SMITH Calling Card.

all.narrate: You name the material out loud and then you make the thing out of it. It is not pretty and it is not going to fail today.
all.broadcast: Something broken is working again, and it was made and not bought.

actions.label: Name a person who owes you. They must help you, now.
actions.detail: Not a favour. A debt, and you are calling it in.
actions._ability: THE LEDGER — once per session, printed on the TRADER Calling Card.

all.narrate: You say the amount, and the month, and what it was for. They do not enjoy it and they help you anyway.
all.broadcast: A debt gets called in, out loud, in front of everybody.

actions.label: Name a real document to make the room reconsider.
actions.detail: Chapter and verse. +1 Legacy.
actions._ability: CHAPTER AND VERSE — once per session, printed on the CLERK Calling Card.

all.narrate: You name the document, the date on it, and the clause. The room does not have to agree with you. The room does have to deal with it.
all.broadcast: Somebody has cited chapter and verse, and the room is reconsidering.

actions.label: Clear one Resolve box from your company.
actions.detail: Everyone in your company, wherever they are standing.
actions._ability: HANDS — once per session, printed on the HEALER Calling Card.

all.narrate: You go round your own company one at a time and put them back together. Nobody rolls for this. It works because you did it.
all.broadcast: A whole company is back on its feet.

actions.label: Assert a claim of long standing.
actions.detail: No one out-argues it without producing a document.
actions._ability: OLDER THAN YOUR DEED — once per session, printed on the RANCHERO Calling Card.

all.narrate: Your family was running stock on this ground before the paperwork existed. Anybody who wants to argue can go and find the paper first.
all.broadcast: A claim older than the deed just got asserted, and nobody has the document.

actions.label: Declare the true number. Food, powder, or time.
actions.detail: Everyone must act on it. Everyone can see it after this.
actions._ability: HOW MANY DAYS — once per session, printed on the HOUSEHOLDER Calling Card.

all.narrate: You say the real number out loud, and it is smaller than the one people had been using. Now everybody is working from the same figure.
all.broadcast: The true number is on the table, and it is not the one anybody wanted.
